subject.title: Discord: Support messageUpdate and messageDelete events for edit-to-reprocess and delete-to-cancel

question: Should Discord message edits and deletes become default-on behavior that reprocesses edited source messages and cancels runs keyed to the exact deleted source message?
rationale: The issue asks for new visible Discord channel semantics and the active PR implements them without a new config surface; current labels and review history already mark this as needing product direction before merge.

options.title: Accept default-on Discord edit/delete semantics
options.body: Keep the behavior in the bundled Discord plugin and require the linked PR to provide the remaining code fix and live Discord proof before merge.

options.title: Require an opt-in Discord setting
options.body: Ask the PR to preserve current behavior by default and add a documented opt-in if maintainers want a compatibility gate.

options.title: Pause for broader cross-channel semantics
options.body: Defer this Discord-only change until maintainers settle the cross-channel recall/edit cancellation model tracked separately.

recommendation.title: Accept default-on Discord edit/delete semantics
recommendation.body: Keep the behavior in the bundled Discord plugin and require the linked PR to provide the remaining code fix and live Discord proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The relevant history points most strongly to repeated Discord monitor/startup ownership around the affected code path.
